post.title: [Hiring] Social media manager for a local bakery - $500/month
post.body: We are a family bakery wanting someone to run our Instagram and Facebook: 3 posts a week, reply to comments, and a monthly report. We take the photos. $500 a month, 3-month trial.

analysis.summary: Run a bakery's Instagram and Facebook (3 posts a week, comment replies, monthly report); $500/month, 3-month trial.

expect: leans on general experience without claiming social media management expertise
does not invent follower growth numbers
